cursor-auto.source: Estimate, and an API-EQUIVALENT COMPARISON RATE rather than money billed. The cursor seat runs on a flat $20/month Cursor Pro subscription, so marginal per-token cost is plan-included until the allowance is spent. Cursor publishes no per-token rate for plain Auto on an individual Pro plan; these figures mirror the published Auto Cost flat rate ($1.25 / $6 / $0.25 per Mtok) as the nearest documented number. Probed 2026-08-19 on the live account: GET /v1/agents/{id}/usage answers `feature_unavailable`, so there is no server-reported cost to reconcile against, and the Auto Balance router variant is not offered at all (no `optimize_for` parameter on any model) — see docs/cursor-seat-findings.md.
